type.description: The stable category URI. Switch on this, never on `title`.

bearerAuth.description: A `telmoni_` API token, minted on the Keys page. The token IS the organization; there is no second credential and no scope below the organization.

info.description: The API a `telmoni_` token opens. Every response that is not a success is an RFC 9457 problem document, and a client switches on its `type` rather than on its prose.
info.title: Telmoni API

get.description: Everyone in the organization, the owner first, with the role each holds. The same body the console reads, so a token and a browser cannot be told two different member lists.

200.description: The members: the owner, then everyone else newest first.

401.description: No live `telmoni_` token was presented. A revoked, expired or unknown token answers the same way.

429.description: Too many requests. The front door meters by source and by token before the request reaches a service, and says when to come back in `Retry-After`.

503.description: The lane is switched off, or something it needs did not answer. `Retry-After` says when to try again.

get.description: The organization the token belongs to — its id, its name and its owner's address and name. A token IS an organization, so this answers for the caller and for nobody else.
